summary: Search the catalogue for a tool by name
description: Shoppers arrive knowing roughly what they want — "pliers", "hammer" — and the catalogue runs to several pages. Search has to narrow it, say what it found, and be undoable.
acceptanceCriteria: Searching for a term returns only products whose name or description contains that term.
The results caption states the number of matches and the term searched for, in the form "<n> products found for <term>".
A search that matches nothing shows no products, and the caption states "0 products found".
Clearing the search restores the unfiltered first page of the catalogue.
